description: Report the current authentication state without calling TronSave: `authMode` (none | api-key | signature), `source` (login | header), `walletAddress`, `hasInternalApiKey`, `expiresAt`, network, and which tool groups are available now. Call this first when unsure whether to log in, and after `SESSION_REQUIRED` / `INVALID_SESSION_TYPE` errors.
name: tronsave_get_session_status

anyOf.description: `signature` unlocks wallet tools; `api-key` unlocks internal-account tools.

authMode.description: `signature` unlocks wallet tools; `api-key` unlocks internal-account tools.

anyOf.description: Whether any credential is active for this request.

authenticated.description: Whether any credential is active for this request.

anyOf.description: Tool groups callable with the current auth.

availableNow.description: Tool groups callable with the current auth.

anyOf.description: Whether an internal API key is available for api-key tools.

hasInternalApiKey.description: Whether an internal API key is available for api-key tools.

anyOf.description: Present when header credentials were sent but rejected.

headerAuthError.description: Present when header credentials were sent but rejected.

anyOf.description: Wallet of the signature identity, if any.

walletAddress.description: Wallet of the signature identity, if any.

title: Session Status
